broad.text: His 36 projects lead with AI agents and automation. Start with these three: Inbound: Scout, the inbox agent Uzair built for himself: read-only Gmail, a live journal, memory and a daily briefing. Backroom: An AI back-office agent for a fictional restaurant group: read documents, reconcile payouts and cite every number. Agent Desk: Two AI agents on one site: Patch looks after a GitHub account, Pitch drafts LinkedIn posts. 33 others: 7 Flagship, 3 AI apps (Flowboard, Sayso, Hindsight), 5 LLM and agents, 3 Quant and markets, 13 Data and analytics, 2 Games and play.

broad.q: Which project should I look at first?
broad.text: Start with Inbound. Rules classify and extract locally, keeping source quotes and found, inferred, unknown or conflicting status for each field. Alternatively, Backroom: An AI back-office agent for a fictional restaurant group: read documents, reconcile payouts and cite every number. Alternatively, Agent Desk: Two AI agents on one site: Patch looks after a GitHub account, Pitch drafts LinkedIn posts. For front-end work, the Projects folder also includes Sayso.
